title: Coast: A short love story
overview: Two exes, one car, and a long drive up the California coast to a wedding neither of them wants to be at. Elsie needed a ride and Matt was the only one who picked up the phone. Somewhere between the breakfast burritos and the old arguments, they start circling the question of whether the timing was ever going to work.
